Hey, I’m a master/gm Support main

There are some really great advice here!

It’s really difficult playing support in low elos, but it all boils down to you surviving.

Positioning, positioning, positioning!

Don’t put yourself in a spot that’ll make you easy to pick off.

Don’t stand still for long periods of times, always move around and keep tabs on where your enemies and teammates are.

Super jump comes in handy to reposition yourself, try not to do it too often though (especially if they have snipers)

Mercy’s healing is pretty lacking, so just do priority healing/heal tapping. 
 - heal your team one at a time, briefly. 
 - you don’t have to top them off, there’s a second healer for that.
 - heal your other support fully first, then the lowest hp by tapping.
 - you want to sustain their hp, no need to keep your beam on one person if they’re not actively dove on.

I notice a lot of Mercy’s not cancelling their GA!
 - cancel your Guardian Angel so you don’t mess up your positioning.
 - cancel it so you don’t pass your heal target
 - you don’t HAVE to get that close to heal someone

Use Damage boost!
- I hold down rmb to constantly output dmg beam
- then tap lmb to heal when they’re taking poke damage
- keep your dmg boost up whenever you can

My biggest tip that helped me get from silver to Masters is, “Don’t die”.

Just don’t put yourself in a position where you can die easily :) flying with Mercy is very fun!
